verdict.rationale: The official README documents Docker and Kubernetes installs (kubectl, kustomize, or Helm) alongside pip/uv, and the getting-started docs promise a first conversation in under five minutes. That covers two of the story's four targets in substance. Nothing in the pack shows a dedicated, maintained guide for each target. Missing for 10: explicit Docker Compose guide, small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence that each deployment guide is separately maintained, independent hands-on corroboration of the install paths.
